Third-party pure-Python packages shipped with Para v13 (no pip on user PCs).
  openpyxl 3.1.5   - MIT  (licenses/openpyxl-3.1.5)
  et_xmlfile 2.0.0 - MIT  (licenses/et_xmlfile-2.0.0), required by openpyxl
Unpacked unchanged from the PyPI wheels. To upgrade: download the wheels, unpack here,
keep the license files, delete *.dist-info, run tests/test_deploy_files.py.
